target.title: fix(scripts): keep format-docs output tails UTF-8 safe
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where `scripts/format-docs.mjs` could render a replacement
character (�) in failure diagnostics when a formatter (oxfmt) error
output exceeded the 16 KiB tail cap and the byte window started inside a
multibyte UTF-8 character.

## Why This Change Was Made

`outputTail` took a byte-bounded suffix with
`bytes.subarray(-N).toString("utf8")` before decoding.  When the retained
byte window started at a UTF-8 continuation byte the tail began with a
replacement character.  A new `decodeUtf8Tail` helper now skips any
leading continuation bytes, matching the existing pattern from the sibling
fix in `scripts/run-additional-boundary-checks.mjs` (#109167).

## User Impact

Docs formatting failure diagnostics stay readable when capped output
contains multibyte text (e.g. oxfmt errors on CJK documentation pages) at
the retention boundary.  No behaviour change for ASCII-only output.

## Evidence

- Before the fix, `node -e` confirmed that the last 4 bytes of
  `Buffer.from("你好")` (boundary at continuation byte 0xA0) produced a
  leading `�`.
- After the fix, the same input produces `"好"` — the continuation byte
  is skipped and the intact character follows.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/format-docs.test.ts -- -t decodeUtf8`
  passed with 3 tests (continuation-byte skip, ASCII passthrough, empty
  buffer).
- `oxfmt --check` passed on both changed files.
